response.content: {"functions": [{"node_id": "Bio/SeqUtils/__init__.py:192:GC_skew", "docstring": "Calculates the GC skew (G-C)/(G+C) for consecutive windows along a nucleotide sequence, returning one ratio per window in sequence order. Both uppercase and lowercase G and C characters are counted; ambiguous nucleotides are ignored. Windows containing no G or C nucleotides yield 0.0 rather than raising a division error. The number of values equals ceil(len(seq) / window), with the final window possibly shorter than the others when the sequence length is not a multiple of the window size. No exceptions are raised for normal inputs. Args: seq (str): The nucleotide sequence to analyze. window (int, optional): The window size in bases used to partition the sequence. Defaults to 100. Returns: List[float]: The GC skew ratio (G-C)/(G+C) computed for each window along the sequence."}]}
